criterion_text: On a supported real Linux FUSE runner, an already verified EROFS image mounts read-only into an existing Sandbox composition and unmounts with owned-resource cleanup; digest mismatch, missing helpers/capabilities and invalid source root fail closed without Native fallback. The Sandbox retains root composition and execution authority.

verifiers.summary: A verified EROFS image mounts read-only into an existing Sandbox composition and cleans up only owned mounts, while missing helpers, wrong bytes, unauthorized sources and unsupported capabilities fail closed without Native fallback

evidence.value: exact runner capability receipt: platform=linux backend=linux-bwrap namespaces={"cgroup":true,"ipc":true,"net":true,"pid":true,"user":true,"uts":true} seccomp=true filesystem=true erofs=true erofs_overlay=true network_deny=true network_restricted=true cgroup_v2=["cpu","cpuset","io","memory","pids"]

executions 54a9e6a7-5dc4-49ef-ab1d-bf57cf8f4b73 and d3b3dc42-e161-4482-be41-d4b4b71d71a6 mounted the same Base/Project/toolchain images read-only through the extracted primitive; cleaning the first unmounted only its 4 mounts and left the second's 4 live

missing erofsfuse/fusermount, a non-executable helper, a digest mismatch, a source outside the authorized image root and unsupported EROFS/overlay capabilities all failed closed; no Native fallback substituted
